title: Example Overview
description: Starter example: one KPI row and a monthly trend, driven by two named queries. Replace the table refs with real tables from get_client_schema.

kpis.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders, ROUND(SUM(total), 2) AS revenue FROM `your-gcp-project.example_client.main_orders` WHERE DATE(order_date) BETWEEN DATE(@date_start) AND DATE(@date_end)

monthly.sql: SELECT FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', DATE(order_date)) AS month, ROUND(SUM(total), 2) AS revenue FROM `your-gcp-project.example_client.main_orders` WHERE DATE(order_date) BETWEEN DATE(@date_start) AND DATE(@date_end) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
